_comment: Model matrix for the Stage 5 Part 4 persona-persistence eval harness.
Edit `models` to whatever you actually want auditioned. Each entry is either a
plain string (a model id or a unique substring) or an object:
params_b is optional — when present the harness also reports the SMALLEST passing model.
The `model` value is resolved against LM Studio's live model list the same way the
audition picker resolves --model: exact id wins, else a UNIQUE substring match. A model
that isn't loaded (no match) is marked SKIP, not failed. Copy exact ids from LM Studio
or the `L`-key picker if a substring is ambiguous.
Override at run time with:  python eval_persona_matrix.py --models id1,id2,id3
